leadText: This is a list of themes that have been played in the dub of the Pokémon animated series. The second season and the fourth through the eleventh used the English openings.
plainText:
This is a list of themes that have been played in the dub of the Pokémon animated series. The second season and the fourth through the eleventh used the English openings.

==Openings==
The dub used the English version of the Pokémon Theme, however, this song was featured on Pokémon - Μουσική από την τηλεοπτική σειρά.
